description: This file defines a static class ResponsePool for managing object pooling of Response<T> objects, including methods to get and return objects, with an internal generic class TypedPool to hold pools for specific types.

classes.name: TypedPool<T>
classes.description: A generic internal class holding a static pool for Response<T> objects.

methods.name: Get<T>
methods.description: Retrieves a Response<T> object from the pool.

methods.name: Return<T>
methods.description: Returns a Response<T> object to the pool.
